final: WITH player_averages AS (SELECT p.player_id, p.bats AS batting_hand, AVG(bp.double) AS average_doubles FROM batting_postseason AS bp JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = bp.player_id GROUP BY p.player_id, p.bats), indexed AS (SELECT player_id, batting_hand, average_doubles, average_doubles / (SELECT AVG(average_doubles) FROM player_averages) AS player_index FROM player_averages), hand_averages AS (SELECT batting_hand, AVG(player_index) AS hand_average_index FROM indexed GROUP BY batting_hand) SELECT i.player_id, i.batting_hand, i.average_doubles, i.player_index, i.player_index - h.hand_average_index AS gap FROM indexed AS i JOIN hand_averages AS h ON i.batting_hand IS h.batting_hand ORDER BY gap DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
